name: Revenge Exacted
summary: Belgrom Rockmaul in Orgrimmar asks you to bring him Magus Rimtori’s head from Azshara. He wants to see it for himself.

sections.title: Belgrom’s Request
sections.body: In Orgrimmar, Belgrom Rockmaul fears that Ag'tor and the others are dead after hearing you bring news from Azshara. He asks you to bring Magus Rimtori’s head to him, so he can see it for himself.

sections.title: A Bitter Grievance
sections.body: Belgrom looks into the sack and laughs with hatred. He accuses Magus Rimtori of betraying him.

faq.q: Who asks for Magus Rimtori’s head?
faq.answer: Belgrom Rockmaul in Orgrimmar asks you to bring him Magus Rimtori’s head.

faq.q: Where does Belgrom want you to bring the head?
faq.answer: Belgrom wants you to bring Magus Rimtori’s head to him in Orgrimmar.

faq.q: What does Belgrom fear after hearing from Azshara?
faq.answer: Belgrom fears that Ag'tor and the others are dead.
